title.narrative: Hygiene Promotion Support to CARITAS Malakal in MELUT and Manyo Counties

description.narrative: CARITAS Malakal is a strategic partner of CAFOD in South Sudan responding to the current crisis in Upper Nile state. Phase I of the Emergency Response is in 3 villages with a population of about 7500 people i.e. about 1,500 households. CARITAS Malakal/CAFOD is targeting these 1,500 households. Four (4) local Water maintenance and 3 local Bio-Sand filters (BSF) technicians have been identified to support with the projects in Kashaba Torkuach and Mabek. Two WASH Officers (Hard Ware), one incoming, and 2 Hygiene Promotion Officers’ (HPOs) have been recruited, by the Partner CARITAS Malakal, to oversee the WASH Hard programme. In Phase II of the Emergency Response, Caritas DoM is targeting about 1,600 HH (9,600 persons) in 6 locations (Noun, Dielal Ajak, Nyawutthuro, Athidwoy, Thuro and Nyilyec) in Manyo County. CARITAS Malakal/CAFOD will be intervening in the Areas of WASH (hygiene promotion, construction of latrines and provision of chlorine water tables), provision of NFIs (shelter, cooking and WASH) and Emergency Livelihoods (unconditional Cash grants) targeting IDPs and vulnerable host community members.
